notes.title: Thank You for Joining Us at LEVEL UP PLAY!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hello players![/b][/h1]

Our team is just unwinding from the recent LEVEL UP PLAY weekend at KLCC and just wanted to say a [b]HUGE THANK YOU[/b] to everyone who came by to try our new convention build or simply had a chat with the team! 

A gentle reminder that if you were given a postcard after playing, there is a [u]Steam Key on the back of the card[/u] that gives you access to our playtest build— which we update from time to time with feature polishes and gameplay improvements. It features [u]two extra levels[/u] compared to what was shown during the event, and [u]more comic cutscenes[/u] that give you more context to the game's story! 


[h2]So, You Already Claimed the Playtest Key...[/h2]

Please join our community in the [url=https://discord.gg/bXHqMjJDpD]Overhours Discord server[/url]! There, you'll be able to leave us with feedback and suggestions as development carries on, and stay-up-to-date with any news from our team. And if you don't have a playtest key, you'll be notified via the server when we open up for more playtesters!

Once again, thank you for your support and we hope to meet everyone soon (or in the server)!ːsteamhappyː
